title: Robust Explanatory Analysis for Structured Optimization Networks (REASON) in Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19378v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We seek a hierarchical resolution of residual error under a composite learning objective as a principled mechanism for identifying and exploiting additional information, particularly under distribution shift and perturbation. Inspired by the System 1/System 2 paradigm, we formulate this principle as a two-loop mechanism serving a common inference goal. A fast, System 1-like loop resolves the residual addressable by the available evidence; the remaining epistemic residual triggers a medium speed, System 2-like loop that actively acquires additional evidence and measures its informational value through residual reduction. Over nested solution spaces, the medium-loop optimum is provably no worse than the fast-loop optimum. translated_title: 学习中结构化优化网络的鲁棒解释性分析
translated_abstract: 我们寻求在复合学习目标下对残差误差进行分层解决，将其作为一种识别和利用额外信息的原则性机制，尤其是在分布偏移和扰动的情况下。受系统1/系统2范式的启发，我们将这一原理表述为服务于同一推理目标的双循环机制。一个快速的、类似系统1的循环负责解决现有证据可处理的残差；剩余的认知性残差则触发一个中等速度的、类似系统2的循环，该循环主动获取额外证据，并通过残差的减少来衡量其信息价值。在嵌套解空间上，可证明中等循环的最优解不劣于快速循环的最优解。实验表明，所得的双循环模型在约为中等循环一半的计算量下持续优于快速循环，包括在未见过的损坏情形下也表现良好，并且当提供更清晰的观测时（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 受系统1/系统2范式启发，提出一种双循环机制，通过分层解决残差误差并主动获取额外证据，在分布偏移和扰动下以约一半的计算量持续优于单循环模型。
en_tdlr: Inspired by the System 1/System 2 paradigm, we propose a two-loop mechanism that hierarchically resolves residual error and actively acquires additional evidence, consistently outperforming the fast loop at roughly half the medium loop's computation under distribution shift and perturbations.
